h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bokaro

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bokaro

items.pText: Bokaro Steel City in Jharkhand is a planned township built around its steel plant, with sectors, wide roads and parks that date back several decades. Much of the play equipment in older parks and school grounds here is now worn out. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,450 km away, and supplies schools, township parks, housing societies and private colonies in Bokaro.

Replacing old equipment raises questions a new playground does not. Can the old footings be reused? Should the layout stay the same? What about the trees that have grown up around it? In most cases we suggest new footings, because old concrete may not match the base of new equipment. We also suggest a fresh look at the layout, since today's safe play areas may need more space than the old pieces had.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Replacing worn equipment in an older park

c: Send us photos of the park as it is now, including the old equipment, trees and paths, with rough measurements. We prepare a new layout with the safe play area for each piece, which tells you whether the old footprint still works.
Painted metal equipment that has rusted through is best taken out. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic hold up much better through Jharkhand's hot summers and heavy monsoon. A wooden tower from

facts.value: About 1,450 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can new playground equipment use the old footings?
items.a: Usually not. Old footings may not match the base of new equipment, and the safe play areas may differ. We plan new footings on the layout drawing for each piece.

items.q: How do we plan a park upgrade around grown trees?
items.a: Send photos and rough measurements showing tree positions. We place the equipment so trees stay outside the safe play areas and give shade where it helps most.

items.q: Do you supply playground equipment to Bokaro?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture in Vasai and send the equipment to Bokaro by road. Our team or a dealer serving Jharkhand installs it.
